reviews.title: Plug-n-Play (Literally) and well-built 18.5 inch Monitor with ALL the necessary accessories!
reviews.comment: Hello, This is my second such product, a portable monitor, that I can use for a portable workstation during travel or work-from-home setups. My first such monitor is 14.5 inch portable monitor. This one is 18.5 inch monitor. I ended up ordering this for longer office hours and my gaming experience while travelling. All in all, a pretty solid product. It comes with all accessories you can think of. The build quality is very solid. Weight is light enough for this sized monitor, i.e. moderately light to give you well-manufacured product feeling. The performance is top notch. The usage is flawless; literally plug-n-play; I had to do nothing except connecting one cord between the monitor and my laptop. It powered itself on, did a handshake with my monitor over USB C, adjusted the aspect ratio, and lit up perfectly as a duplicate screen. I set it as extended second screen, and next time I connected them, it lit up as extended screen by default. Supprr impressed! This is my highlight of the review: one connection and you are rolling! The brightness is more than adequate for a well lit room for sure. It comes with an in-built stand that can be used to set it at different viewing angles in horizontal layout. The stand is stable at any angle and doesn't give itself out. It has VESA mount compatibility as well and comes with fours screws that can secure a VESA mount to it, so if you have a stand or a mount, it can be used in horizontal or portrait mode. Other usages I can think of is using this as a screen with my Xbox while travelling, as it comes with a mini HDMI to HDMI cable, it has in-built speakers, and it comes with a 3.5 mm audio jack. It also has 120Hz refresh rate and blue light filter for extended usage. For the price point, the product packs everything you can think of at a very affordable value. There are some products which can mount directly on your laptop. But I believe, those products are inteded to be used in very specific scenarios and will fit the need of a specific user base. While this product can serve multiple usages. Overall, super user friendly plug-n-play and well built product with all the required accessories in the box. Highly recommended if you need a portable 18.5 inch monitor.
reviews.author: Yugz

reviews.title: Good product overall
reviews.comment: Sometimes I wished I would have bought the touchscreen version. Good product though. I recommend you don’t use UltraHDR mode, and keep the brightness at 50-60% because the screen can crash if it draws too much power, but it’s a portable monitor, so it’s understandable in my opinion. I also ended up upgrading the power brick to a more powerful PD adapter, which really helped increase the stability. Another con would be the sound volume, would have been nice if it was maybe twice as loud. Other than that, it can smoothly do 120Hz, the mini cable works well and the monitor seamlessly switches between mini HDMI and USB-C. One thing to note is that the bottom port is mini HDMI, the middle port is USB-C for display, and the top one is USB-C power only. You could accidentally plug your computer into the top port and think that the monitor doesn’t work — you should use the middle port. Finally, I love the portability. You don’t necessarily have to plug the monitor into power, it can also take power from your laptop (but don’t expect top-performance that way), but sometimes I take my monitor, my laptop, and a USB 4.0 cable with me on the go, and it works well as a secondary screen that way! ~ those are the times I wish it was touchscreen, but it works great as it is.. good value for the price.
reviews.author: Max

reviews.title: Perfect portable monitor for my Legion Go
reviews.comment: I bought this mainly to use with my Legion Go, and it works great. The 18.5" screen size is much bigger than most portable monitors, which makes gaming and multitasking way better than trying to use a small handheld screen. The 120Hz refresh rate is smooth, and the picture looks sharp with good brightness and colors. It connected easily using USB-C and worked right away without any issues. I also like the built-in kickstand, which makes it easy to set up anywhere, and it comes with a protective sleeve for travel. The monitor is thin and lightweight but still feels solid. Overall this is a great portable second screen for laptops, handheld gaming PCs, or consoles. Really happy with it.

reviews.title: Portable Screen Perfect for Work While On-the-Go
reviews.comment: I've had this monitor since late March and it has completely changed how I work when I travel. As someone who relies on multiple screens to stay productive, being stuck on just my laptop screen was always a struggle so I had to get a portable monitor. It's 18.5 inches, so it's a real working second screen. Big enough to have documents, emails, or reference material up side by side without squinting. And it's less than a third of an inch thin!! I'm not exaggerating when I say it slides into my bag like it's nothing. Light, slim, and takes up zero space in my backpack. Setup could not be easier, I just need a USB-C, plug it in, you're working in seconds and there's no drivers to install.  The matte screen is great for different lighting environments, which matters when you're hopping between offices, and coffee shops. If you work remotely, travel for work, or just need a reliable second screen outside your home office, this is absolutely worth it. I won't travel for work without it now.
reviews.author: Kim
